svg.title: Model interpretation methods answer different predictive questions
svg.desc: A five-row matrix compares gain, permutation importance, partial dependence, ICE and SHAP by question and limitation. A dark boundary states that none of these methods alone identifies causal ecological mechanism.
svg.text: Interpret the fitted function without inventing a mechanism

g.text: XGBoost gain
Which split features improved the training objective?
internal credit; correlated substitutes divide unevenly
global · training behaviour
Permutation
How much does held-out score degrade when disrupted?
model, metric and data dependent; correlation masks reliance
global · evaluation reliance
Partial dependence
What average model response follows a feature grid?
can create unsupported combinations under dependence
global · fitted response
ICE
How does that model response vary among observations?
individual curves are not intervention trajectories
local-to-global · heterogeneity
SHAP
How is one model output allocated from a reference?
depends on model, background and dependence assumptions
local and global · attribution

svg.text: Predictive reliance or attribution ≠ ecological intervention ≠ causal mechanism. Check fold stability, correlation and applicability first.
